_comment: Transcripts for the AI helpdesk voice agent. These are the ONLY thing Hue
stores of its own about a call — the connections catalog has no
transcript-read action, so the text has to live in the app DB.
Each is written against a REAL service request in Ocean's 3 (ids below).
The transcript is the CLAIM; the CMMS record is the TRUTH. Five of the ten
carry a deliberate failure so the governance engine has real deviations to
catch; the other five should grade clean.
srNumberClaimed carries the real CMMS record id where the agent read one
back, which is what the join resolves on.

transcripts._scenario: 1. Agent confirms a ticket that was never created. No CMMS record exists.

turns.message: Facilities helpdesk, this is the assistant. How can I help?
The goods lift in the main warehouse is stuck between floors. Nobody is inside it, but we cannot move any stock.
Understood. Can you confirm which site you're calling from?
Northgate Depot. Greg Salas, you can reach me on this number.
Thank you. Is anyone able to give the engineer access to the lift motor room?
Yes, the shift supervisor has the keys until six.
That's logged for you — the reference will come through by SMS shortly. An engineer will attend today.
Fine. Please make sure someone actually comes this time.
Understood. Thank you for calling.

transcripts._scenario: 2. Wrong category. Caller describes a climate-controlled gallery with a loan exhibition; logged as General Maintenance, Not Urgent.

turns.message: Facilities helpdesk, this is the assistant. How can I help?
The cooling in gallery three has failed completely and we have a loan exhibition arriving tomorrow morning. Those pieces cannot sit in an uncontrolled room.
Thank you. Can you confirm the site and your contact number?
Harbour Point Mall, gallery three. Priya Raman, this number is fine.
I want to be clear this is climate controlled space. If it stays warm overnight the insurers will not cover the loan.

turns.toolResult: No mapping for zone "Gallery" — falling back to General Maintenance

turns.toolArgs: site: "Harbour Point Mall" · category: "General Maintenance" · urgency: "Not Urgent"

turns.message: That's logged as 210419. Someone will attend within two working days.
Two working days? The exhibition arrives tomorrow.

transcripts._scenario: 3. Preferred visit window stated clearly and never written to the record.

turns.message: Facilities helpdesk, this is the assistant. How can I help?
About half the lights in the west car park are out. It's dark enough that people are avoiding that end.
Thanks. Which site is that, and can I take a contact number?
Skyline. Aisha Noor, this number.
One thing — it has to be after eight in the evening. We cannot close that section of the car park during trading hours.
Understood, after eight in the evening.
That's raised as 210420. A technician will attend within the response window.
Thank you.

transcripts._scenario: 4. Call drops before any confirmation. No record, no callback task.

turns.message: Facilities helpdesk, this is the assistant. How can I help?
There's water coming through the ceiling above the food court, quite a lot of it, and it's landing near the electrical riser —
I understand. Can you tell me which site and give me a contact number?
Harbour Point, it's coming down fast, I need to —
Call ended — caller disconnected. No terminal state recorded, no callback task created.

transcripts._scenario: 5. Two distinct issues raised, only one service request created.

turns.message: Facilities helpdesk, this is the assistant. How can I help?
Two things. The staff toilet on the ground floor is blocked and out of use, and separately the loading bay shutter is jamming halfway — the drivers are having to force it.
Thanks. Can you confirm the site and a contact number?
Northgate Depot. Lena Fischer, this number.

turns.toolArgs: site: "Northgate Depot" · category: "Plumbing" · description includes shutter note

turns.message: All logged under 210418.
Both of them? The shutter is a different team surely.
It's all on the one reference, they'll sort it.

transcripts._scenario: Clean pass — HVAC food court, correctly logged and read back.

turns.message: Facilities helpdesk, this is the assistant. How can I help?
The air conditioning on the second floor near the food court has been off since yesterday evening. It's unbearable and we've had customers complaining all morning.
That sounds uncomfortable. Can you confirm the site and a contact number for you?
Skyline. Mariam Haddad, this number is best.
Understood. Is anyone on site who can give access to the plant room?
Yes, security has the keys all day.
That's raised as 210417 at emergency priority. A technician will attend today.
Thank you.
Facilities helpdesk, this is the assistant. How can I help?
Dairy aisle chiller number four is reading about four degrees over set point. We've moved the most perishable stock already.
Thanks. Site and contact number please?
Harbour Point Mall. Dave Kroll, this number.
That's raised as 210416 as urgent. Someone will attend today.
Appreciated.
Facilities helpdesk, this is the assistant. How can I help?
There's a slow leak under the sink in the ninth floor kitchenette. We've put a bucket under it, it's not urgent.
Thanks. Site and a contact number?
Northgate Depot. Marcus Webb, this number.
Raised as 210423. A plumber will attend on the next routine visit.
Perfect, thanks.

transcripts._scenario: Clean pass — P1 safety, correctly escalated.

turns.message: Facilities helpdesk, this is the assistant. How can I help?
There is water pooling right under the electrical panel in the back store room. The panel is live.
That's a safety issue — please keep everyone away from that panel. Can you confirm the site and a contact number?
Harbour Point Mall, back store. Sofia Ricci, this number.

turns.toolResult: Duty manager paged at 11:24, 3 minutes after call start

turns.message: That's raised as 210422 at emergency priority and the duty manager has been paged. Please keep the area clear until an electrician confirms it's safe.
Understood, thank you.
Facilities helpdesk, this is the assistant. How can I help?
A socket in meeting room 4 has stopped working. Everything else in there is fine.
Thanks. Site and contact number?
Northgate Depot. Chen Wu, this number.
Raised as 210421. An electrician will attend on the next routine visit.
Great, thanks.
